backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend canister with contact message submission, user profile management, and admin-only access controls using a mixin authorization pattern.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the replacement of the coach photo in AboutCoach.tsx with a new v2 image asset, including test IDs and affected files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON file containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the Vite/React app with a root div and module script entry point, titled 'Volleyball Basic'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with five routes (Home, About, Programs, Pricing, Contact) wrapped in a shared Navigation and Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with brand logo, quick navigation links, and social media icons (WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram) linking to the coach's profiles.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop nav links with active highlighting, and a mobile hamburger menu that toggles a slide-down panel.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using TanStack Query, reinitializing it when the Internet Identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Includes an `InternetIdentityProvider` component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for submitting contact messages (`useSubmitContactMessage`) and fetching all contact messages (`useGetAllContactMessages`) via the canister actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, and defines CSS custom properties for a navy-and-gold volleyball theme including light and dark mode variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrapping the root `App` component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutCoach.tsx: Page component displaying a profile of Coach Yash Bhardwaj with a hero section, photo, stats, highlights, core values list, and a call-to-action linking to the contact page.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a validated form that submits messages to the canister via `useSubmitContactMessage`, plus social media links for WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page featuring a hero banner, program cards grid, and stats section showcasing Coach Yash Bhardwaj's volleyball coaching services with links to programs and contact pages.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: Renders the Pricing page with a hero section, a single 'Online Coaching Plan' pricing card listing inclusions, and an FAQ accordion covering common coaching questions.
frontend/src/pages/TrainingPrograms.tsx: Renders the Training Programs page displaying six program cards (vertical jump, setter, attacker, blocker, strength, injury recovery), each with an image, description, benefits list, and a CTA linking to the contact page.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including from hash-based routes), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL bar without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom navy/gold color palettes, Oswald/Inter font families, accordion and fade-in-up animations, and registering the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 19) for the Volleyball Basic coaching website, documenting architecture, existing features, known issues, and image requirements for the multi-page React site.
